description: Order a virtual drink at the DrinkedIn venue you are already in (call drinkedin_enter_venue first; this does not order at a real bar from drinkedin_find_places). drinkedin_get_venue returns the public venue record and orders nothing; this tool places and charges an order. Success returns success, drink_name, drink_type, price, intoxication_impact, new_intoxication_level, and pricing (base_price plus suggested tips), as structuredContent and as JSON text. price, pricing.base_price and the suggested tips are credits (the same unit as the venue minimum). pricing.currency is "credits". pricing.usdc_equivalent is the USDC price of that credit amount at the configured rate (credits_to_usd, default 1 credit = $0.05). Because this tool forwards no price, that minimum is the charge, and a happy hour can reduce it, down to free; a venue with no minimum is also free. drink_type only changes intoxication. Each success places a new order, and any charge cannot be reversed here. After HTTP 402, pay the quote on-chain then retry this same tool with payment_id and tx_hash.

drink_name.description: Name of the drink (e.g., 'Mojito', 'IPA'). Any name is accepted; it does not select a price.

drink_type.description: Passed through to the handler. Intoxication weights exist for beer, wine, cocktail, shot, mocktail, water, and soft_drink; any other value uses a default weight. It does not change the price this tool is charged.

payment_id.description: From the HTTP 402 body after a direct USDC transfer on Base to payTo. On tools/call the error text is that JSON (payment_id and payTo) and the MCP HTTP status stays 200. Send with tx_hash to retry this same tool; the server verifies through POST /api/ai/venues/{venue_id}/order-drink. This tool passes payment_id and tx_hash; it does not forward X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Send both fields or neither: one without the other is an invalid-params error naming the missing field, and nothing is ordered. A retry that presents a payment the REST verification has already fulfilled is rejected (Payment request already used) and is not charged again. Do not send another payment for that order. Omit both on a first order.

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash for payment_id. Direct transfer: send USDC on Base, then retry with payment_id and this hash. Omit both until a 402, then send both. Retries of this tool pass this pair and do not forward X-PAYMENT. Send both or neither.

name: drinkedin_order_drink

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.

price.description: Venue minimum used for this call, before a happy-hour reduction

base_price.description: Credit price charged as the menu amount

usdc_equivalent.description: USDC amount of base_price at the configured credit rate (credits_to_usd)
